## Accepted restricted result and exact scope

Problem 4600046 / AMR-045-0046 remains unresolved for arbitrary full-shift cellular automata. The shared proof-route budget is exhausted at 5/5; verification/publication add zero routes. This target-only draft publishes six corrected restricted propositions and the complete independent audit. The work and independent audit are AI-assisted. No novelty, exhaustive worldwide literature status, conventional human peer review, journal acceptance or proof-assistant verification is claimed.

The exact model is a nonempty finite alphabet, d >= 2, the full shift over Z^d and one finite translation-invariant local rule. Periodic means finite shift orbit, equivalently the union of Fix(n Z^d). A and B retain the actual specified quiescent q; C has no such hypothesis. A is periodic-injective implies q-finite-onto, B is q-finite-onto implies periodic-onto, and C is globally-onto implies periodic-onto. All unrestricted forms remain unresolved. Periodic lifts may enlarge the target period.

Accepted results: the exact torus collar criterion without automatic collar existence; the ternary marker inverse, pointwise continuous on F_2 but not uniformly continuous and with no full-shift continuous extension; the Garden-of-Eden-dependent 2r fixed-fibre boundary bound and zero entropy without a periodic-point conclusion; the universal directed-cycle criterion and explicit power-of-two periodic lifts for fixed-control one-successor XOR rules; q-finite surjectivity from periodic injectivity in that same family at the actual q including nonzero signal background; and exposed-vertex-permutive periodic lifting with the stated longitudinal bound and exact target phase. The controlled XOR family yields A/B/C only in that family. Exposed-vertex permutivity yields B/C only, not A. No global full-shift antecedent is inferred from finite tests.

## Correction, full audit and public boundary

The sole mathematical correction is the empty-displacement-set convention R = max({1} union {infinity norm(s): s in S}). The contextual CORRECTION.patch is preserved and was applied locally with zero fuzz and no offset. Publication-only prose cleanup removes nonmathematical authoring/bookkeeping and stale status language while preserving all mathematics and scope. Its public change description contains no removed coordination text. The complete independent AUDIT_REPORT.md is byte-preserved. Old source/input manifests, superseded full reports, the original assertion checker and unsafe input/audit harnesses are omitted.

The current independent explicit-exception verifier retains every mathematical solver and all eleven actual algorithm/hypothesis mutations, adapted only to public pins/paths and isolated execution. The correction checker recovers the current clean proof by exact unique mathematical-context replay in memory and checks degenerate cases. Both have authored adaptation patches. Historical references in the full audit describe original work, not public replay of omitted inputs. All originals remain unchanged locally.

Public source metadata records Jarkko Kari, Cellular Automata, Spring 2026: https://users.utu.fi/jkari/wp-content/uploads/sites/1251/2026/02/fullnotes.pdf. The reused PDF is 1,332,765 bytes, SHA-256 f75bb1abe3102afe2d2e3e32fb6a2a69d441034c0b8224e9c40b2e4793e22bb9, retrieved 2026-10-09T00:42:31.183721+00:00. Its recorded visual/text inspection scope and Garden-of-Eden dependency remain explicit. This publication stage performs no new download or literature search. No PDF, rendered page, extracted source text, external dataset contents, private sources, private coordination, identifying metadata for excluded private files, QUEUE or unrelated repository changes are included.

## Verification and limits

Normal/-O/-OO run under actual UID=EUID1000 and -I -S -B against physically read-only files/directories. Each mode has two positive checker runs and eleven mathematical algorithm/hypothesis rejections, 6 positives and 33 rejections over three modes. The mathematical mutants address loops, cycle parity, odd/arbitrary-even cover multipliers, nonstrict cover bound, zero winding, falsely uniform inverse radius, replaced q, thin collar, omitted target phase and dropped exposedness. Their intended reasons are exact. Integrity, schema and output-comparator controls are separate and add no mathematical coverage.

The independent positive covers 700 functional graphs / 10,552 binary targets; 1,296 routing patterns with 425 accepted / 871 rejected, 6,800 lifts / 1,632 odd base parities and m=4; stress covers through 4,096 vertices; 729 marker targets with unique support fibres; specified beta_0=1; 7,928 collar incidences; and 239 exposed-vertex lifts with absolute phase/unimodular checks. Correction diagnostics add 274 empty-routing identity targets and six singleton-alphabet cases. Universal conclusions and infinite-graph existence remain written mathematical proofs.

Complete raw stdout/stderr equals reviewed mode-specific references without normalization. Recursive exact JSON types, identities, exits, counts and reasons are independently enforced. Hostile imports must reproduce the entire clean baseline exactly. UID1000 create/append-open/unlink attempts must physically fail, and whole-delivery snapshots stay unchanged. Original assertion/input/historical harness replay, superseded-report replay, source body replay, new-source search, dataset replay and formal proof-assistant verification are NOT_RUN.

Authenticate BOOTSTRAP.py against the external SHA-256 below, copy it outside the packet, and run using trusted CPython/stdlib and read-only delivery modes 0555/0444:

    python -I -S -B /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
    python -I -S -B -O /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
    python -I -S -B -OO /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet

The noncircular exact recursive manifest binds every delivered file except itself and the externally authenticated bootstrap; the bootstrap binds the manifest, verifier and control harness. A hash learned solely from the candidate is not independent trust. Final receipts remain outside the delivered inventory, with pins below. POSIX modes do not protect against deliberate owner chmod or root. The actual additive diff is independently reapplied to a new location and replayed under all three modes.
